dashboard.label: TA-amdgpu Overview
dashboard.description: Collects AMD GPU telemetry from /sys/class/drm/cardN/device (VRAM used/total, busy %, temperature via associated hwmon) and /sys/class/kfd (GPU count, memory info) when AMD GPUs

search.query: index=main sourcetype="amdgpu:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="amdgpu.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="amdgpu:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
